text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yo... hop...♪ New high score set!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking past an arcade, I 
saw Tokai Teio playing a dance game. A 
large crowd of girls surrounded the 
machine.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Teio-chan, you're amazing! So cool~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With loud applause and cheers following 
every single session, one would think 
Tokai Teio would be thrilled. Or so I 
thought...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Muuu.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haaah~... What should I do...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh hey, you... You were watching me 
dance before, weren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then you remember, right? I worked super 
hard to make that game popular.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right now, everyone's only looking at 
me... It feels like nobody's actually 
enjoying the game itself.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Of course, getting praised so much makes 
me happy, but~
choice_data_list: You want everyone to play together, right?

You'd rather have everyone join in the 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! That's it! I wonder what I 
should do~.
choice_data_list: How about having another girl play it?

What if you danced together with the 
audience?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Eh, someone other than me? Why's that!
choice_data_list:
Maybe it'll feel more approachable to 
them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Tokai Teio was the only one playing, 
she might be so good that people felt 
intimidated to try it themselves.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, looking at it from that perspective 
makes sense. I see, I see~...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, got it! I'll bring in some 
backup!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—So, why me? Because you figured I 
wouldn't be able to handle a dance game?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But you can totally dance, Nature. 
The deciding factor was just that you 
looked free!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't make such a scary face! I'm 
starting the game now~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wait, wha— I don't even know the 
controls yet, hello?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! I'll be your escort and guide 
you♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Whoa, wait, umm...?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nature, like this! Just like this! Now 
step out just the same...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You're super good at this♪ Keep it 
up and stay right with me!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, 3rd place on the arcade 
leaderboard...?! 3rd place here too, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
For your first time, that's amazing! Well, 
still not quite up to my level, though♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You really didn't need to add that second 
part. Though... well, I guess it's not 
bad.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...I thought just watching this game was 
enough, but... maybe I'll try playing it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh, looks like a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What is?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nature, well done! As a reward for your 
splendid efforts, I shall bestow upon thee 
a treat of Hachimii~♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Why...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They might not feel up to playing alone, 
but having a partner might lower the 
barrier for their hesitant hearts.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, doesn't that game 
have a pair dance mode?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~ I wouldn't mind escorting them, 
but... Just saying 'Okay, one at a time, 
please☆' is~... so lame!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I mean, their partner would be none other 
than ME! Handing it out like cheap fan 
service just feels wrong~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right. If they want me... they've gotta 
work hard for it, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—So, whoever wants to be escorted by me, 
raise your hands!

text_block_list.name: Gallery
text_block_list.text:
ME!! Me me me me! Pick me pick me pick me 
pick meeeee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that's more like it♪ But since I 
can't dance with everyone...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoever comes out on top in this game gets 
the privilege of dancing with me!

text_block_list.name: Gallery
text_block_list.text: Ehhhh~...?!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I really wanna dance with Teio-chan, 
but... I've only ever watched this game...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph~. So, you're not going to take my 
hand then?

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text: ...Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No giving up! If you want me, you've gotta 
put in the effort. You can do your best 
for my sake, right? ...Can't you?

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text: ...Nghhhhh!! Yes, Lady Teio............!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, a sudden battle for Tokai Teio 
began. At first, everyone was bewildered 
by the unfamiliar game, but...

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on... my feet are getting 
totally tangled up here?!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Haha, but this is so fun! I definitely 
want to beat my high score!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, everyone's got great expressions. I, 
the great one, am thoroughly satisfied~♪
